aliases.description: Other names it goes by, such as those of pitches combined into it by a merge (DUP-7); imports and pickers find the pitch by them.

position.description: Where the pitch itself is, which can be some way from the venue's address.

markings.description: Its corners as marked on the watch, oldest first (TRK-13). Each is used for matches kicking off after it, until a later one.
